developerName.description: Represents the API name of the topic instruction. Can contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters and must be unique in your org. It must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores.

language.description: The language of the topic instruction.

masterLabel.description: The master label for the topic instruction.

sortOrder.description: A numerical value used to determine the order the instructions will be executed in.
